mapper.select: SELECT B.IPTN_DTM::DATE AS iptnDtm, B.EXM_DT::DATE AS exmDt, (SELECT Z.ORD_NM FROM ODS.S_CCOOCBAC Z WHERE Z.ORD_CD = A.ORD_CD) AS ordNm, B.IPTN_CNCS_CNTE AS iptnCncsCnte, B.TH1_IPTN_EXPL AS th1IptnExpl, C.COPN_CNTE AS copnCnte, (SELECT Z.STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = B.TH1_IPDR_STF_NO) AS th1IpdrStfNm, (SELECT Z.STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = B.TH2_IPDR_STF_NO) AS th2IpdrStfNm, (SELECT Z.STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = B.TH3_IPDR_STF_NO) AS th3IpdrStfNm, (SELECT Z.STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = B.TH4_IPDR_STF_NO) AS th4IpdrStfNm, (SELECT Z.STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = B.TH5_IPDR_STF_NO) AS th5IpdrStfNm, (SELECT Z.STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = B.TH6_IPDR_STF_NO) AS th6IpdrStfNm FROM ODS.S_MSERMAAD A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MSERMDDD B ON A.IPTN_NO = B.IPTN_NO INNER JOIN ODS.S_MOOOREXM C ON A.ORD_ID = C.ORD_ID WHERE A.IPTN_NO = #{iptnNo};
